rule_first_print_any_side: First public print that rounds to 95–99¢, that outcome held to official resolve.
rule_first_buy: First BUY print (lift ask) that rounds to 95–99¢.
rule_ever_max: If a side’s max print in last T seconds rounds to that tick, hold that side to resolve.
rule_snapshot: Richer last print at T seconds left, if it rounds into 95–99¢.

recommendation.sample: BTC 5m, 14d, 4007 resolved, first BUY print in window, 7% fee, hold to official resolve

safest_tick_if_you_can_fill.why: Lowest reverse rate among taker combos whose 95% CI still clears fee breakeven. Reverse 1.43%, wr 98.57%, +0.44¢/share. 98¢ last 30/45s is −EV. 99¢ never clears breakeven as a taker BUY.

best_ev_tick.why: Highest pnl/share among large-n BUY rows. Reverse 2.55% but win pays ~4.7¢ vs 99¢ paying 0.93¢.

best_balance.why: 96¢ last 3 minutes: reverse ~2.0% (better than 95), EV +1.75¢/share (4× 98¢). CI clears breakeven cleanly. 25.8 wins offset one $25 blowup vs 53 at 98 and 106 at 99.

best_window.why: 180s and full 5m (300s) are almost the same tape. 900s adds nothing. Last 30–45s is adverse selection: 97/98/99 go −EV; 96 stays barely +EV; 95@30s is flat.

bot_settings_if_following_tape.note: Band 96–98, last 3 minutes. Skip 99 as taker. Do not stack. Snapshot-99 with 30s left is safer (0.11% reverse) but that ask is usually gone after itode.

recommendation.sample: BTC 5m, 30d, first BUY print in window, 7% fee, hold to official resolve

bot_settings_if_following_tape.note: Keep 96–98 last 3 minutes unless 30d tape flips 98 last 180s to −EV. Skip 99 as taker.

safest_tick_if_you_can_fill.why: Lowest reverse among large-n taker combos whose 95% CI still clears fee breakeven.

best_balance.why: 96¢ last 3 minutes: more edge per share than 98, lower reverse than 95.

best_window.why: 180s ≈ full 5m. Last 30–45s is leftover size / adverse selection.

recommendation.vs_14d: The extra 16 days were choppier. Last-180s reverse rose: 95¢ 2.58%→3.26%, 96¢ 1.99%→2.47%, 97¢ 1.82%→2.23%, 98¢ 1.43%→1.71%, 99¢ 1.12%→1.17%. 98¢ last 180s is still +0.16¢/share but the 95% CI no longer clears fee breakeven. 99¢ last 180s CI [98.58%, 99.04%] sits entirely below the 99.07% wr needed. 96–97 last 3 minutes remain the robust +EV band; skip taker 99; avoid last 30–45s.

honest: 99¢ is not certain. One dump after you lift is −~99¢/share vs +~0.93¢ if you win.
Win rate at 99¢ can look 98–99% and still be −EV after fees if blowups are fat.
Prints that already traded are not your 250ms FAK fill. Live fill rate is lower.
5m books can trade before the BTC window; this study keeps last 900s only.
